note: Research tally. A hit is an observed checkpoint where every measured series (price and liquidity) moves the whale's way at +1h, +6h, or +24h. A wrong-way observation is a miss. No observation is unobserved and is not a miss. n_observed is hits plus misses. Rates stay blank under 8 observed checkpoints on that horizon. eligible_for_active needs at least 25 observed checkpoints and a hit rate above 55% at both 6h and 24h. Past checkpoints use the nearest desk-data print (ADA/qty, and pool ADA when a snapshot is inside the tolerance). Nothing is promoted automatically. Not a buy signal.
